# 1. Contrast Interpretation

The contrasts used in this analysis are designed to distinguish differences between diet groups at each visit from longitudinal changes between visits.

**1. High vs. Low Processed Diet Average (H_vs_L)**
   Identifies genes and pathways that differ between the High- and Low-processed diet groups when considering the          average difference across V1 and V2.

**2. Highly Processed Diet: V2 vs. V1 (H_V2vsV1)**
   Identifies genes and pathways that change between Visit 1 and Visit 2 within the High-diet group.
   
**3. Low Processed Diet: V2 vs. V1 (L_V2vsV1)**
   Identifies genes and pathways that change between Visit 1 and Visit 2 within the Low-diet group.
   
**4. High vs. Low Processed Diet at V1 (V1_HvsL)**
   Identifies genes and pathways whose expression differs between the High- and Low-diet groups at Visit 1.
        
**5. High vs. Low Processed Diet at V2 (V2_HvsL)**
   Identifies genes and pathways whose expression differs between the High- and Low-diet groups at Visit 2.
        
   
# 1. GSEA DotPlots
```{r cGSEA, eval=TRUE}

heatmapChunk_GSEA <- c(
  '## {{j}} {.tabset} \n\n',
  '. \n\n'
)

heatmapChunkLoop_GSEA <- c(
  '```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8} \n',
  'ggarrange(bulk$plots$gsea[["{{j}}"]][["{{i}}"]], legend = "right") \n',
'``` \n')


```

```{r GSEAplots, eval=TRUE, results='asis'}

# dotplots

for(j in names(bulk$plots$gsea)){
  cat(knitr::knit_child(text = knitr::knit_expand(
        text = heatmapChunk_GSEA,
        j = ifelse(j == "H",'Hallmark', 
                   ifelse(j == 'GOBP','Gene Ontology Biological Processes',"Cononical Pathways"))
      ), quiet = TRUE), sep = '\n')
  out <- NULL
for(i in names(bulk$plots$gsea[[j]])){
  out <- c(out,paste0("### ", i, "\n\n"), knitr::knit_expand(text = heatmapChunkLoop_GSEA))
}
  cat(knitr::knit_child(text = out, quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
}

```


# 2. GSEA Leading Edge Genes
```{r cGSEA_leading_edge, eval=TRUE}
heatmapChunk_GSEA_leading_edge <- c(
  '## {{j}} {.tabset} \n\n'
)

heatmapChunk_Contrast_GSEA_leading_edge <- c(
  '### {{con}} {.tabset} \n\n'
)

heatmapChunkLoop_GSEA_leading_edge <- c(
  '#### {{i}} \n\n',
  '```{r GSEA_{{j}}_{{con}}_{{i}}, fig.width=10, fig.height=8, echo=FALSE} \n',
  'ggarrange(bulk[["plots"]][["gsea_leadingEdgeHM"]][["{{j}}"]][["{{con}}"]][["{{i}}"]], legend = "right") \n',
  '``` \n\n'
)
```

```{r GSEA_leading_edge_plots, eval=TRUE, results='asis'}

for (j in names(bulk$plots$gsea_leadingEdgeHM)) {
  
  # ============================================================
  # LEVEL 1: Gene set database
  # ============================================================
  
  j_label <- ifelse(
    j == "H",
    "Hallmark",
    ifelse(
      j == "GOBP",
      "Gene Ontology Biological Processes",
      "Canonical Pathways"
    )
  )
  
  cat(
    knitr::knit_child(
      text = knitr::knit_expand(
        text = heatmapChunk_GSEA_leading_edge,
        j = j_label
      ),
      quiet = TRUE
    ),
    sep = "\n"
  )
  
  
  # ============================================================
  # LEVEL 2: Contrasts
  # ============================================================
  
  for (con in names(
    bulk[["plots"]][["gsea_leadingEdgeHM"]][[j]]
  )) {
    
    cat(
      knitr::knit_child(
        text = knitr::knit_expand(
          text = heatmapChunk_Contrast_GSEA_leading_edge,
          con = con
        ),
        quiet = TRUE
      ),
      sep = "\n"
    )
    
    
    # ==========================================================
    # LEVEL 3: Pathways
    # ==========================================================
    
    for (i in names(
      bulk[["plots"]][["gsea_leadingEdgeHM"]][[j]][[con]]
    )) {
      
      cat(
        knitr::knit_child(
          text = knitr::knit_expand(
            text = heatmapChunkLoop_GSEA_leading_edge,
            j = j,
            con = con,
            i = i
          ),
          quiet = TRUE
        ),
        sep = "\n"
      )
    }
  }
}
```
